selection_policy.full_sampling: uniform downsample over eligible frames, capped by max_full_frames
selection_policy.random_subset: deterministic scene-keyed random sample from full frames
priority_order: WildRGBD RGB + sensor depth + npz camera pose
DL3DV images_8 + transforms pose + COLMAP photometric depth
optional ScanNet color + pose only when --include-pose-only is set
